about_the_game:
Join the Eggpans, a delightful and quirky group of frying pans with an insatiable desire to fry eggs in this relaxing, cute and bite-sized Sokoban puzzle adventure.

Take control of the Eggpan, a frying pan on a mission to fry eggs, and uncover the lore hidden among the scattered islands. Push tree trunks, roll mischievous fire piggies and hunt for keys to unlock new paths across the map. With each puzzle solved, you’ll uncover pieces of a larger story that binds the Eggpans to their purpose—and reveals what lies beyond their obsession with frying eggs.

Piece together the pages of lore to uncover the true history of the Eggpans and the secret that awaits them.

  • A cute Sokoban puzzle game with bite-sized challenges.

  • Simple yet challenging mechanics, featuring eggpans and fire piggies that interact with each other and the environment to solve the puzzles

  • 100 puzzle isles to solve and some will have you stop and think.

  • 90 - 120 minutes of playtime. Ideal for a single playthrough.

  • The lore pieces will make sense once you piece them all together. I promise.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
